chapter: Photographs: Eddie Miller, Shields and Willow band
title: Tape running out; photographs sent to a magazine
summary: Claire cautions that the tape is almost finished, and explains why the photos were not used by Howard Jacobs.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Don't you say anything interesting for a minute? It's almost ready to run off. Okay. Oh, you go on for a few minutes here, but it's getting close to the end.
Okay, when it runs off we'll get into something else.
Oh yeah, I see you got everybody's name underneath. In the back end too, because he didn't remember why he did that. Mm-hmm.

Because Howard Jacobs had said he would use that, and then he kept them for about six months, and I think somebody else sent in some pictures similar, and this week didn't want to use it then. I don't know.
